0022600209.text: The Phoenix Suns (3-5, 12th in the West, 3rd in the Pacific and 4.5 games back) host the San Antonio Spurs (8-2, 1st in the Southwest and 3rd in the West) in the Suns' ninth game of the season, with Phoenix at 3-2 at home and 0-3 on the road. Phoenix is missing Jordan Goodwin (calf) and Mark Williams (shoulder, surgery), while San Antonio is without Devin Vassell (groin), Jayden Quaintance (knee, surgery), and Tobias Harris (calf strain). The teams have not met yet in 2026-27, and their 2025-26 season series was split 2-2, with the Suns' most recent meeting a 101-100 loss in San Antonio on March 19, 2026.
